verdict.rationale: Least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question for an agent-extension system that also has a hosted Skills API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials, keys, or tokens for an agent. The only related controls are over which skills Claude may invoke (frontmatter invocation control, SDK skill allowlisting) and workspace-private skill availability, and those are not credential scoping.
